The '''discovery of Alaris Prime'''<ref name="Fact">{{FactFile|42|KAS 1-4|Kashyyyk}}</ref> by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Scout/Legends|explorers]]<ref name="GB" /> occurred between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]].<ref name="NEC & GB" /> [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Alaris Expanse]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] that was geographically hidden by the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]].<ref name="GB" /> As a consequence, the moon had been untouched by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] community for close to [[1002 BBY|one thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]], when it had been the site of a [[Skirmish on Alaris Prime|skirmish]] in the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="Bane">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'' describes a [[Skirmish on Alaris Prime|skirmish]] occurring on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] in [[1002 BBY]]. Therefore, for Alaris Prime to be an uncolonized moon as described in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', it must have disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] view after 1002 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Independent Wookiee explorers from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in the same [[Star system/Legends|star system]] discovered Alaris Prime<ref name="GB" /> when their [[Species/Legends|species]] began to venture to other worlds.<ref name="Fact" />

The Wookiees subsequently [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|petitioned]] the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to give them [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] rights to the moon. After two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of [[Politics/Legends|political]] debate, Alaris Prime was [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|awarded]] to the Wookiees, who colonized the moon<ref name="GB" /> sometime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC & GB" /> There, they [[Alaris Prime colonial war|fought]] against an illegal [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] presence, after which Alaris Prime became a thriving community within the Republic.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The discovery of Alaris Prime was first mentioned in the databank entry for Alaris Prime in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" /> It was identified in the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 42|forty-second issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'', a magazine<ref name="Fact" /> written by [[Iain Lowson]]<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> and published by [[De Agostini]] around [[October 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Date">{{FFdates|42}}</ref>
